headline: Election Commission to discuss 2026 State Primary update, District 1 City Council Special Election, and SAVE system Supreme Court decision.
summary: The commission will review the 2026 State Primary and Election Update, covering vote by mail, early voting, and polling locations. It will also discuss the District 1 City Council Special Election, the SAVE system US Supreme Court Decision, legislation to separate municipal census and voter registration (H.799/S.503), and the Commissioner's role for State Election.

plain_text:
Election Commission Meeting 
Tuesday, October 13, 2026 
Elections Department Conference Room, Lowell City Hall 
5:30 – 6:30 p.m. 
Public Participation 
Members of the public who wish to speak about a specific agenda item must register to speak in advance of the 
meeting by sending an email to the City of Lowell Elections and Census Office showing the agenda item. The 
email address is elections@lowellma.gov. If you do not have access to email, you may contact the office at 
(978) 674-4046. 
Agenda 
1. Minutes 
a. Approval of the old minutes of July 14 
2. New Business 
a. 2026 State Primary and Election Update 
i. Vote by Mail  
ii. Early Voting  
iii. Polling locations 
3. District 1 City Council Special Election 
4. Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements, or SAVE system US Supreme Court Decision 
5. Separating Municipal Census & Voter Registration Legislation (H.799 filed by Rep. Shirley Arriaga/ 
S.503 filed by Sen. Cindy Creem) 
6. Discussion on the Commissioner's role for State Election
